content.summary: Aga Khan University Language Policy Thinking Group meet in Dar es Salaam.

media.caption: Members of the Aga Khan Language Policy Thinking Group (LPTG) meet at Salama House, AKU, Dar es Salaam.
media.alt: Aga Khan University Language Policy Thinking Group

content.text: The second meeting of the Aga Khan Language Policy Thinking Group (LPTG) took place at Salama House, AKU, Dar es Salaam on 19th and 20th January 2017. The ELE_net Director, Roger Smith, is Vice-Chair of this group, and Dan Raynor (ELE_net eLearning Specialist) attended as an observer.

The aim of the LPTG is to build an evidence base to inform the development of an effective language policy for AKU. The focus of the meeting in Tanzania was to consider the literature review emanating from the first meeting in Karachi in October 2016 and to agree on the additional research needed to develop the evidence base. The final meeting of the LPTG will take place in London in June 2017.

From right to left: Dr Yasmine El Masri (LPTG Research Coordinator, OUCEA, University of Oxford), Daniel Raynor (eLearning Specialist, ELE_net, AKU), Dr Tashmin Khamis (Director of QAI_net and T&L_net, AKU), Carol Ariano (Vice President Human Resources, AKU), Dr David Arthur (Dean of School of Nursing and Midwifery, AKU), Professor Pauline Rea-Dickins (Chair of LPTG, OUCEA, University of Oxford), Elizabeth Shepherd (Senior Researcher, British Council), Roger Smith (Director, ELE_net, AKU), Dr Ahmar Mahboob (Associate Professor, University of Sydney), Dr David Taylor (Director of ISMC, AKU), Louis Ariano (Associate Vice-Provost and University Registrar, AKU)
